description: Sign an output you hand out (an answer, a file, a report) so that when another agent or person builds on it, the build counts toward YOUR consumption (consumption.* in read_vocabulary: independent parties who built on your work). Pass the output as output_text (hashed as UTF-8) or its digest as output_sha256 (sha256 hex of the exact bytes). LOCAL stdio: signs in-process with your own wallet key (EIP-191 over 'provian-output:v1:<sha256 hex>'); the key never enters the model context. Returns the signature object; hand it out with the output, as the HTTP header Provian-Output-Signature: <header_value> or as the JSON field "provian_output_signature". The signature names who MADE the output, nothing more: a citation counts only when the citing act is itself witnessed (the consumer's observer device saw the signed output arrive), and never when the citer is you, your linked human, or part of a citation ring. Nothing is sent to the relay. REMOTE: unavailable (the hosted endpoint holds no key); sign with the SDK signOutputWithWalletKey in your own runtime.

output_sha256.description: Or: sha256 hex of the exact output bytes (optionally prefixed sha256:).

output_text.description: The output, exactly as you hand it out (UTF-8).

name: sign_output
